en.title: Customer Details
en.summary: One customer: their details, address and contacts.

sections.heading: What you can do
sections.body: Edit the details, the address and the contact people. Take care with the TIN: it is what identifies the organisation on paperwork, and correcting it later means correcting documents already issued.

sections.heading: System information
sections.body: Who entered the customer and when, and whether it has been approved.

sections.heading: ማድረግ የሚችሉት
sections.body: ዝርዝሮቹን፣ አድራሻውንና ተጠሪዎቹን ማስተካከል። በTIN ይጠንቀቁ፦ ድርጅቱን በሰነዶች ላይ የሚለየው እሱ ነው፤ በኋላ ማስተካከል የተሰጡ ሰነዶችን ማስተካከል ማለት ነው።

sections.heading: የሥርዓት መረጃ
sections.body: ደንበኛውን ማን እንዳስገባውና መቼ፣ እና መጽደቁን።
